versions.changelog: Adds HIPAA Safe Harbor mode: on a Safe Harbor / US de-identification request, redacts all dates (not just DOB), all specific ages, and the remaining HIPAA identifiers (fax, licence, device serial, VIN, health-plan numbers).

Adds re-identification (scripts/reinstate.py) to restore originals from a token map — completing the redact → process → re-identify round trip. Adds a self-check pass to the workflow. Clarifies relatives/carers handling. New tests and eval cases.

v1: Regex-based pseudonymisation for NHS numbers, DOBs, postcodes, phones, emails, hospital numbers, NI numbers. Agent reasoning for patient names, addresses, ages. Labelled tokens, redaction reports.
